title: PaneNode Enum
description: Tree node representing either a split container or a leaf pane in a cluster's layout.
signature: pub enum PaneNode { Split { id: String, dir: SplitDir, sizes: Vec<f32>, children: Vec<PaneNode> }, Leaf { id: String, tabs: Vec<String>, active_tab: Option<String> } }
semantics: Represents the immutable structure of a cluster's pane tree; mutations are pure functions.
